steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: All the Reunion members have been captured. None of them knew anything about the specific instructions...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en? What are you looking at that has you so absorbed?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Didn't this used to be University Road?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hmm? Seems so. Its name was changed later.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I think this is where my home used to be...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wasn't your apartment in Tai Bo?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This was the estate that belonged to my biological father's clan. Looks like it's been renovated. So much time has passed that I barely recognize it anymore.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did you live here before studying abroad in Victoria?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Even though I've heard that both you and Mister Wei were born to Yan aristocrats, it's really quite astonishing to see a mansion this big.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Aristocrats? They were, but I'm not.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But, your mansion here... How should I call it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmm, the Ch'en Estate will do...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Woah woah, isn't this your own house? Why'd you slice the door open?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I forgot to bring the key. Besides, Reunion also just opened a hole along the side wall. They might have caused some unexpected damage.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That doesn't mean you should— Ah, forget it. If you say so.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No need to take off your shoes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you serious? Ch'en, answer me honestly, do you hate your old man?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: He doesn't deserve to be my father.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If I remember correctly, you joined the L.G.D. right after you graduated from Victoria and returned to Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I was living in the dorms at the time.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So, you never returned here after that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have no lingering attachments to this place.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: People who say stuff like that usually have a lot more going on in their mind.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Anyways, do you have any ideas about what this high-value target might be?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: She's deep in her own little world again, huh.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, I'll be waiting by the door. Call me when you're ready to go.
Keep all the toys orderly.
Do not go outside.
Do not talk to anyone without permission.
Do not make eye contact with adults without permission.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You really kept this room clean all this time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph. How generous of you to keep a tidy bed for me. Or is this some kind of malediction because you think I'm bad luck?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wait, the photo... Right, the photo...
You shall receive no love from me, not in the slightest.
Sorry. I'm sorry, but I can't stand you. Just seeing you makes me want to peel my skin off my arms.
I cannot tolerate any of you. I am too selfish, but I can't live like this anymore.
One day, all of you will understand. If you hate me, so be it. Because I hate you too. And that's how it should be.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Here it is.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A photo from such a long time ago... I thought it had been lost.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wait, no... could this be what they're searching for?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What's going on? Why would they be after this? Have you lost your marbles as well?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll certainly help you, but what are you thinking? Why here, why now?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ah... What'd I expect. Of course you won't answer me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah, are you finally ready to go?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We're going.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did you get any leads? Or did you want to play with the balls of yarn a bit longer?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hard to believe you're still in the mood to crack jokes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I think your mood is just a tiny bit better than it was before though.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's as you said. Maybe I did have a bit too much on my mind.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's right, according to the reports, Reunion is scattered throughout this entire area, and the forces we deployed earlier are driving them out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's good. That makes our job easier, and we're getting closer to our goal.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: L.G.D., get into formation and move out! We're going to take back Lungmen!
